title: Fortune Brands Innovations Declares Quarterly Dividend
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Fortune Brands Innovations, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
DEERFIELD, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 29, 2026-- Fortune Brands Innovations, Inc. (NYSE: FBIN), an industry-leading home, security and digital products company, today announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.26 per common share. The dividend is payable on December 9, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 20, 2026.


**About Fortune Brands Innovations**


Fortune Brands Innovations, Inc. (NYSE: FBIN) is an industry-leading home, security and digital products company. The Company makes innovative, reliable products that contribute to safety, enhance sustainability and provide luxury for residential and commercial customers. The Company’s trusted brands include Moen, House of Rohl, Aqualisa, SpringWell, Therma-Tru, Larson, Fiberon, Master Lock, Sentry Safe and Yale residential. Learn more at[www.fbin.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.fbin.com&esheet=54612963&newsitemid=20260929463465&lan=en-US&anchor=www.fbin.com&index=1&md5=1a5d205e406df22c087310bbff32f55b) .
